title: OPENED PIXEL CONTAINERS
why: The 86e picture critic found opened container bodies too dark against the scene. Raise pixel opacity by 16 percent while keeping the lifted lid, cache, footprint and hidden loot colours unchanged.
now: Opened pixel containers are easier to read at a glance.
